scientific_integrity: The arclength minimum and standard Korobov equality example are credited to established results; the additional claim is the full uniqueness/equality classification of arbitrary rectifiable minimizers.
scientific_limitations: Only closed unweighted arclength box-frequency torus design curves exactly attaining the sharp bound; no quantitative near-equality stability, weighted rules, total-degree or hyperbolic-cross claim. Finite checks are not general proofs.
title: Rigidity of every shortest box-Fourier design curve on a torus
